text_to_image_prompt: Photorealistic photographic studio character asset, natural skin pores and fine individual hair, realistic cotton and knit detail. Pure white seamless background, bright soft frontal daylight balanced fill, low shadows, realistic 50mm lens perspective, no plastic skin, no illustration or 3D, no text or labels or logos. Preserve individual face, skin tone and age from reference. One original fictional adult man, age 23–27. East Asian man, medium-length wavy black shag hair with a slightly long nape, dreamy artistic presence, slate-blue cardigan over charcoal tank top. Invented facial structure: heart-shaped face with generous cheek width, softly rounded chin, slender arched brows, slightly wide-set narrow almond eyes, short straight nose with a delicate rounded tip, gently curved full lower lip and narrow upper lip. Neutral fair skin. Slate-blue textured knit cardigan worn open over charcoal ribbed tank, black wide-leg wool trousers and black suede loafers. Exactly nine head-and-shoulders portraits of this ONE SAME person in a clean 3 by 3 equal panel expression grid, every face front-facing eye-level same scale and consistent face hair clothes. Row1 neutral, gentle closed-mouth smile, happy open smile; row2 surprise mouth O, worried frown, quiet sadness; row3 focused anger, skeptical raised eyebrow, playful small wink. Expressions clearly distinct but attractive and natural. Full hair and shoulders inside each cell. Square overall canvas. Narrow white gutters, no text.
